description: This file defines a PHP class VacancyMenuConfigurator that implements the MenuConfigurator interface for configuring menu items related to the 'Vacancy' section in the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It uses traits and methods to override the screen view for job vacancy management.

classes.name: VacancyMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class responsible for configuring menu with respect to recruitments, particularly handling screen overrides for job vacancies.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the screen to 'viewJobVacancy' for current module; returns null indicating no menu item is directly added.
